_about: Which Soarix edition gets what. Build a feature once, in the folder that fits it best, and every edition that should have it receives it automatically. See editions/README.md.

tiers.note: tools and settings every edition has (command line included)
the graphical desktop, its windows, icons and wallpapers; the server edition includes the desktop
hosting tools that only the server edition has

who_decides: The license key decides which edition image a computer may download (the license server refuses the rest). Inside an edition, every tool built for it or for an edition below it is included.
